subject: Intro: aligning execs for Citrine demo — time and sponsor confirmation
messages:
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
From: Maya Patel <maya@citrine.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Subject: Quick intro — prospective demo and exec alignment

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for taking the meeting earlier this month with our solutions team. We’ve had a good internal discussion and Rajesh (VP of Platforms) wants to see a short executive-level demo focused on inference economics and security controls. He’ll only be able to join for 35–40 minutes, and he specifically asked to hear about predictable latency (SLOs), private deployment options, and the Dedicated offering.

Can we lock a time next week for a brief sponsor demo and an intro to your VP/lead who would typically own these conversations? Best windows for Rajesh are 7/1 after 2pm ET or 7/2 before 11am ET. If you need, I can include a one-page summary of use cases.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Senior Product Manager, Citrine Analytics
maya@citrine.ai | +1 415-555-1212
[Attachment: Citrine_MVP_Use_Cases.pdf (PDF)]
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0400
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@citrine.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Quick intro — prospective demo and exec alignment

Maya —

Appreciate the context. Rajesh’s priorities are a good fit for what we show. I have a few folks who should join the sponsor session: Laura Bennett (VP, Customer Success) to speak to long-term adoption and SLAs, and Karthik Iyer from Solutions to run a very focused 25–30 minute technical demo and leave ~10 minutes for Rajesh’s questions. Priyom (copied) will own next steps / mutual action plan follow-up.

I have both windows blocked on my side; 7/2 at 10:00am ET works best for our execs. If that’s too soon for Rajesh, 7/1 at 2:30pm ET is our backup. Please confirm which you prefer and whether you want us to use a recording or no-recording — some customers prefer no recording for internal execs.

Proposed agenda (40 minutes):
- 5 min: introductions & objectives (Sergio)
- 25 min: targeted demo — latency, dedicated capacity, private options (Karthik)
- 5 min: operational controls & SLAs (Laura)
- 5 min: Q&A and immediate next steps (Priyom)

If you want, I’ll attach a mutual action plan template after we lock the time.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 617-555-3344
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@citrine.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@citrine.ai>
Subject: Re: Quick intro — prospective demo and exec alignment

Sergio / Maya —

Thanks for circling back. 7/2 at 10:00am ET is tight but doable — I’ll join for 35 minutes and need us to get straight to the business outcomes and risk controls. No recording, please.

A couple of asks for the session:
- If you can show a single example of a production workload (tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency) and what Dedicated would look like financially (ballpark per-month), that would be helpful.
- Any notes on data residency / VPC support we can share with our security team afterward.

See you Thursday.
Rajesh
VP, Platforms | Citrine Analytics
rajesh.k@citrine.ai | +1 212-555-1999
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:09:00 -0400
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@citrine.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@citrine.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Quick intro — prospective demo and exec alignment

Great — thank you, Rajesh. We’ll be no-recording and will keep it tight. Looping in Laura and Karthik so they can tailor the demo to the asks.

Karthik / Laura — quick requests from the customer: a one-slide production snapshot (tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency) and a short cost matrix showing Dedicated vs Hosted for their throughput band. Also a note on VPC/private control plane and any required compliance artifacts. I’ve attached a mutual action plan template we can iterate on.

Karthik — can you confirm that the demo will show a sample 1M tokens/day workload run and the KV/prefix caching impact? If we need extra time we can drop to 30 minutes of demo + 5 minute buffer.

Priyom — please prepare a short MAP with milestones (POC start, procurement, pilot timeline) and we’ll send right after the session.

Thanks all — see you Thursday 10:00am ET.

--
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_Template.xlsx]
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 21:03:00 -0400
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@citrine.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@citrine.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Subject: Follow-up & pre-read for tomorrow’s sponsor session

Hi Rajesh / Maya —

Thanks again for making time. A couple of quick items for a focused 35-minute run tomorrow:
- We’ve attached a one-page production snapshot and cost comparator (see attachment).
- We will not record the session per your request.
- After the demo, Priyom will email a short MAP and a link to the security FAQ and VPC guide for your security team.

If there’s anything else you want covered (e.g., audit logging retention specifics), reply here and Karthik will weave it into the 10–12 minute demo segment.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
